attempts.summary: Extracted OM-1 Mark II candidate facts from public Japanese official spec. Mount is Micro Four Thirds; effective MP ~20.37 (total 22.93); body IBIS is present (sensor-shift 5-axis) with quotes conditionally tied to specific lenses; SyncIS quoted separately, not body stops. LCD is 3.0in 2-axis (tilt/2-axis movable) ~1.62M dots, capacitive touch. EVF OLED ~5.76M dots. Burst distinguishes mechanical/modes (~10fps), silent (~20fps), silent SH1 (~120fps), SH2 (~50fps), and Pro Capture (~20/120/50fps) as separate prebuffer modes, not sustained. Video internal MOV H.264/H.265 LongGOP, C4K/4K up to 60p; exact official integer/standard rates (no guessed fractional). Cards: two SD slots (UHS-I/II), SD/SDHC/SDXC. Weight: 599g with battery+card, 511g body only. Dimensions 134.8x91.6x72.7mm. IP53 conditional on matching lens. Multiple fields unknown/null (price, external RAW, crop/bit-depth, card slot details beyond media).
warnings: Body IBIS row13 is present (sensor-shift 5-axis); row15 '補正段数 8.5' appears under both ボディー単体 (body alone) and シンクロ手ぶれ補正 (SyncIS) entries but each tied to a specific lens; do not conflate SyncIS 8.5 with standalone body stops.
Row15 explicitly gives lens, focal length, and conditions (半押し中手ぶれ補正: Off, frame rate:高速); quote is conditional, not universal.
画素数 row5: カメラ部有効画素数 約2037万 (effective) vs 総画素数 約2293万 (total). Use effective ~20.37MP, not total; not composite high-res.

row57 mixes 連写/低振動連写 (~10fps), 静音連写 (~20fps), 静音連写SH1 (~120fps), SH2 (~50fps), and プロキャプチャー modes (~20/120/50fps). ProCapture is a prebuffer mode, not sustained burst; SH1 fixes focus/exposure to first frame. Distinguish mechanical vs electronic AF/AE conditions; spec does not label all as mechanical/electronic.

row106/107/110/111: official integer fps only (24p/25p/30p/50p/60p). No fractional (e.g. 23.98/29.97) rates given; do not guess. Codec/bitrate: H.264 LongGOP ~102/202Mbps; H.265 ~77/152Mbps. Bit depth, crop, and external RAW not in provided rows (null).
row27 '3.0型2軸可動式' = 2-axis movable (tilt/multi-angle style); not vari-angle. Mechanism label should reflect 2-axis movable, touch=yes capacitive.
row146 IP53 is conditional: performs with company's 防滴 lens; with IP53 lens → IP53, with IPX1 lens → IPX1. IP boolean only per official rating/conditions.
row164 weight basis differs (599g incl. battery+card vs 511g body only); keep split. Dimensions row163 exclude protrusions, CIPA.
row161 battery life ~500 standard / ~1010 eco depends on KIOXIA KSDXU-A064G, IS ON, no flash, CIPA; conditional.
Row1 card slots: both slots SD/SDHC/SDXC UHS-I/II; exact slot media/standards only, no per-slot speed class beyond UHS.
No aperture (wide/tele) or Tough focal data rows provided; treat as null. No price given.

attempts.summary: Candidate facts extracted from official OM SYSTEM OM-3 spec page (JP). Mount Micro Four Thirds (fixed=null). Effective sensor MP ~20.37 (total ~22.93); mount image size 17.4x13.0mm, NOT composite high-res. Body IBIS present, sensor-shift 5-axis; body stops center 6.5 / periphery 5.5 with M.ZUIKO 12-45mm F4.0 PRO at f=45mm, CIPA2024. SyncIS is SEPARATE: 7.5/6.5 center/periphery with 12-100mm F4.0 IS PRO, half-press IBIS off. LCD 3.0in, dual-axis movable (tilt-class, not vari/multi-angle), 1.62M dots 3:2, capacitive touch. EVF OLED ~2.36M dots (optional object). Burst: mechanical ~6fps, low-vib ~5.5fps, silent ~20fps, silent SH1 ~120fps (AF/AE locked frame1, flash prohibited), SH2 ~50fps (limited lenses); ProCapture ~20fps, ProCapture SH1 ~120fps (locked), SH2 ~50fps. Prebuffer not sustained. Video max INTERNAL representative C4K/4K 60p; codec H.264 8bit or H.265 10bit, 4:2:0, LongGOP; exact rates 30p/25p/24p/60p/50p; crop and external RAW not stated. Picture modes Flat/OM-Log400/HLG/OM-Cinema1/2. Battery BLX-1; ~590 standard/~1040 eco shots with bundled battery, CIPA. Weight 496g incl battery+card (no eyecup); body-only 413g. Dimensions 139.3x88.9x45.8mm. One card slot (media SD/SDHC/SDXC UHS-I/II). IP53 with company drip-proof lens (IPX1 lens -> IPX1). Operating temp -10 to +40C. Aperture/focal of body not applicable; MFT mount, fixed=null.
warnings: ProCapture rates are mode names, NOT prebuffer/sustained semantics; may be misread.
SH1/SH2 lock AE/AF frame1 or restrict lenses; not general burst.
IBIS body stops (6.5/6.5) vs SyncIS (7.5/6.5) are separate conditions; do not merge.
SyncIS requires 12-100mm F4.0 IS PRO and half-press IBIS off.
Effective MP (20.37) is not composite/high-res; total MP 22.93 distinct.
IP53 only valid with company drip-proof lens; IPX1 lens degrades to IPX1; IP is boolean+conditions.
No Tough focal data; body has no focal/aperture; not applicable.
Video crop and external RAW not stated; do not guess.
Weight 496g is battery+card, 413g body-only; eyecup excluded.
Battery life measured with bundled battery, CIPA, specific KIOXIA card.
cardSlots count not explicitly enumerated as count; media list only.
No price.
Only 1 spec page row set; unlisted fields remain null.
